title: A year in Charleston; his son is born
summary: He stayed a year or more, helped his father-in-law the contractor, and his first son was born.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, Freddie, when you went back, you stayed longer than -- you stayed a few months then, didn't you?
Where, back in Charleston?
Yeah.
Oh, yeah. I stayed -- let's see. I stayed at least a year or more.
You did?
Yeah.
And, the only way you were earning a living was what?
Well, my father-in-law was a contractor.
Oh, I see.
And I used to help him. After we got married I used to help him.
Right.
And I used to help him quite a bit doing odd jobs and what-not, you know.
Yeah. Yeah.
And then my son was born. My first son.
Oh? Your son was born there?
Yeah.
Well, that was nice.
And, then I left and went to New York. Well, first I left with the band.
You see all that you forgot?
Wait a minute.
